job.job_description:
Job Description:


Were looking for talented Software Engineers (Backend) in our Engineering team to build Zippees tech platform from the ground up.
An incredible 0-1 opportunity to work directly with leadership & drive meaningful impact at a high-growth VC-backed quick commerce startup .
In Person role at our Gurgaon HQ (must be based in Delhi NCR).


What you will do:


As a backend developer at our fast-growing startup, youll play a key role in designing, building, and maintaining robust backend services that power our core products and operations. Youll work closely with product, engineering, and operations teams to deliver scalable APIs and data systems, troubleshoot technical challenges, and continuously improve reliability and performance.


Qualifications:


Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field from a top or accredited college.
1-2 years of core backend experience at a SaaS/B2B tech company or startup.
Working knowledge of Python, RESTful APIs, RDBMS, Django, MySQL, K8S and AWS concepts.
Self-starter with strong problem-solving skills & ability to learn quickly.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
A passion for technology and a desire to hustle it out in a fast-paced startup environment.
A people person with gratitude & integrity.


Bonus points if you have:


Prior knowledge/working experience with software products in Quick Commerce, Logistics, E-commerce SaaS, Warehousing, etc.
Prior experience with version control systems (e.g., Git).


What youll get:


Dynamic & collaborative startup culture where your ideas are valued.
Be part of a VC-backed startup passionate about empowering consumer brands in the quick commerce era.
Hands-on experience working on real projects that impact business.
Mentorship & guidance from top industry experts.
Annual Company Offsite.
Opportunity to learn & grow faster.
